findings.what: Exercise 9.9's six reaction schemes have lost their (i)-(vi) item labels. The book numbers each line -- (i) CH3CH2I, (ii) C6H5N2Cl, (iii) CH3CH2Br, (iv) C6H5NO2, (v) CH3COOH, (vi) C6H5NO2 -- the render prints the six schemes unnumbered, so the sub-items can no longer be cited. The schemes themselves and their reagents are all present and correct.
The folio prints the page number twice: a yellow '279' badge followed by the text '279 Amines'. The book prints '275 Amines' style once -- number in the badge, chapter name beside it.

The exercise numbering is inverted. The book sets the stem numbers 9.5-9.9 in bold in the left margin with the text hanging beside them and the sub-item labels (i), (ii)... in plain roman. The render runs the stem numbers inline inside an indented paragraph ('9.5 How will you convert:', '9.6 Describe a method...', '9.7 Write short notes...', '9.8 Accomplish the following conversions:', '9.9 Give the structures...') and sets the roman sub-labels in bold instead.
The italic locant prefixes are lost: the book sets 'm-bromophenol', 'p-chloroaniline', 'p-bromoaniline' with an italic m- and p-; the render sets all three in plain roman.

Word spaces after the roman labels in exercise 9.7 are dropped: '(i)Carbylamine reaction', '(ii)Diazotisation', '(iii)Hofmann's bromamide reaction', '(iv)Coupling reaction', '(v)Ammonolysis', '(vi)Acetylation', '(vii)Gabriel phthalimide synthesis.'
The red vertical bar the book runs down the right edge of the exercise block (continuing the Exercises section marker) is not drawn in the render.

note: Compared block by block against book page 279. Everything else is present and in order: the carry-over items (b), (iv), (v), (vi) of exercise 9.4 with their formulae; 9.5 (i)-(viii); 9.6; 9.7 (i)-(vii); 9.8 (i)-(ix); and all six 9.9 schemes with their reagents above and below the arrows (NaCN, OH-/Partial hydrolysis, NaOH+Br2; CuCN, H2O/H+, NH3/delta; KCN, LiAlH4, HNO2/0C; Fe/HCl, NaNO2+HCl/273K, H2O/H+/delta; NH3/delta, NaOBr, NaNO2/HCl; Fe/HCl, HNO2/273K, C6H5OH). Those lists keep their (i)-(ix) labels; only 9.9's are gone.
